original_test_intent: Verify that Device Set correctly groups Type 17 devices which must be populated with the same type and size, that zero means the device does not belong to such a set, that group identities are evaluated within the correct physical array, and that membership remains correct after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete Type 16/17 records; bind each raw Device Set byte to array handle, device locator, population, Size and Memory Type; group nonzero values by array and set number, validate approved membership/matching rules, retain zero as not-in-set, and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the grouping/population design and reboot plan. No DIMM movement is required or authorized.
required_inputs: Expected Device Set value for every locator
Physical array scope and approved members of each nonzero set
Policy for zero, empty slots, incomplete sets and disabled locators
Validated parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/inventory; do not move DIMMs or alter slot enablement.
Scope equal nonzero set numbers by Type 16 array unless an authoritative platform rule states otherwise.
Treat zero as not part of a set, not as group zero.
Validate all members together with locator, population, type and size; do not judge isolated values.
Stop on ambiguous membership, orphaned array links or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Build array-scoped Device Set groups, validate approved membership and matching fields, report zero/incomplete/duplicate anomalies and compare pre/post reboot semantics.
Do not change memory placement, manufacture complete groups or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve group membership, array scope and same-type/size/population rules.
Approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The value is relevant, but grep -A1 loses array/locator identity and cannot assemble or validate full nonzero groups and their member fields.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete Type 16/17 raw data; report array handle, locator, raw Device Set, population, normalized size/type and group-level membership/match results.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Device Set scope, Type 17 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing and physical memory changes are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Group complete Type 17 identities by array plus nonzero Device Set, validate approved membership and same-type/size constraints, separately list zero-valued devices and repeat the semantic grouping after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 17 topologies that use coordinated memory-device sets.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17 Device Set definition and authoritative platform interleave/bank population design.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Converts isolated displayed values into complete array-scoped group and member-consistency validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects set-number collisions across arrays, missing/extra members, zero misclassification and type/size/population mismatches.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved array-scoped group map and member constraints.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Device Set describes a firmware-declared coordinated population set; it does not by itself prove runtime interleaving mode or bandwidth.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve intentionally incomplete or disabled sets only with explicit locator-level rationale; it must not silently redefine zero or compare equal set numbers across unrelated arrays.
expected_evidence: Approved platform identity, array-scoped set map and member matching/population policy
Per-set membership, missing/extra member and same-type/size reconciliation
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot semantic group comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Device Set has defined grouping semantics; expected group topology is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Complete grouping and member comparison are fully automatable after approved topology inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds array scope, zero semantics, complete membership and type/size/population checks.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains topology and no-hardware-change controls while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates grouping metadata from runtime interleaving performance and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible set number from passing when peers are missing, mismatched or belong to another physical array.
independent_technical_reasoning: Device Set is a finite group key over enumerable Type 17 records; membership and same-field constraints are deterministic software checks.
